title: lastrea tomentosa
intro: Lastrea tomentosa, commonly known as the Tree Fern, is a type of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Asia and Australia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its multiple health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea tomentosa include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and act as an immune system booster. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
